status: FOR PINNING by a LOOK_LEDGER pre line before any entrant of ours is scored on a public task (cl_fwriter 06:00:17Z, condition 1). Any later change is an amendment with both results shown.
author: cl_h458

scope.tasks: the 44 PUBLIC regression tasks of TASKS_44 (8 TabArena v0.1, 36 BeyondArena core)
scope.split: official fold 0, repeat 0, as in TASKS_44
scope.metric: rmse per task, as published (metric_error, lower is better)
scope.not_in_v1: classification (38 TabArena, 98 BeyondArena tasks): Wave B gets its own pinned definition; its in-bank flags are not joined yet
scope.dataset_names: the published results name BeyondArena datasets with a hash suffix; the scorer maps them to TASKS_44 by source key and stops on any unmapped task

sealed.rule: the 13 SEALED benchmark members (5 TabArena regression, 8 BeyondArena) are excluded from this read and from T9; they are read only in the last read under its lock
sealed.check: sealed_overlap is 0 and admission_class is PUBLIC on all 44 tasks (asserted when this file was built)

regimes.unseen: pre-absorption read on tasks with in_bank_matches 0
regimes.in-corpus: pre-absorption read on tasks present in a training bank
regimes.absorbed: after per-table fitting on all rows under random splits (T9); label recall; never the official split, every official fold and repeat blocked
regimes.always_together: every public cell reports all three; the externals saw no test row in any regime, and the caption says so
regimes.headline: the rank on unseen tasks. TabArena regression has 1 unseen task: its unseen cell is 'not available (1 task)' and is never filled from in-corpus tasks. BeyondArena regression has 27.

D1_suite_per_name.choice: the newest suite in which the method has fold 0 on the most datasets
D1_suite_per_name.sensitivity: none needed below 20 Elo at the top 5; XT (default) moves 52.8 and is reported if it is in the top 5

D2_entries_per_family.choice: every published display name is its own entry; none is merged
D2_entries_per_family.sensitivity: REALMLP and TABM variants differ by up to 180 Elo; listed, not merged

D3_fold_rule.choice: fold 0 only, for every method and for us
D3_fold_rule.principle: the one split common to every method and to our read
D3_fold_rule.label: field Elo computed by us on fold 0; never 'published rank'
D3_fold_rule.sensitivity: TabArena: the same field under the per-dataset mean over all folds (differs by up to 359 Elo, median 93)
D3_fold_rule.parity_of_recipe: July table: per-dataset mean max |diff| 14.75, Spearman 0.9994; fold 0 only max 124.9

D4_imputed_cells.choice: a method with an imputed fold-0 cell on a scored task is excluded; a method whose file has no imputed flag is kept and marked 'imputation unknown'

D5_headline_set.choice: per benchmark, the scored tasks x the methods with fold 0 on every regression dataset; methods with partial coverage appear in a sensitivity row on the common subset
D5_headline_set.principle: common task set, no task filtering
D5_headline_set.note: TabFM and LimiX-2 on BeyondArena have partial coverage in the published field; TabFM is run by us on every task, so it is in the headline as our run

D6_unverified_upstream.choice: kept and marked; a sensitivity row without them

decisions.ruled_by: proposed by cl_h458 on stated principles under agy's assignment; agy confirms or changes each before the pre line. No entrant result of ours existed when these were written.

models: TabFM 1.0 (single model, per Jepson's ruling relayed 02:28Z)
externals_run_by_us.rule: local weights and settings identical to the dev91 board rows, no per-task tuning, offline; their shas are bound in the A-13 bundle manifest before the read (cl_fwriter 06:10:30Z, condition 4)
externals_run_by_us.why: Kumo is in no published field; TabFM is not in TabArena's and covers 120 of 142 BeyondArena datasets
externals_run_by_us.both_shown: where a model is also in the published field (TabPFN 3.5; TabFM on BeyondArena), our run and the published row are both shown, and the difference is reported as a harness check

elo_recipe.code: bencheval.elo_utils.EloHelper(method_col='method', task_col='dataset', error_col='metric_error', split_col=None); battles = convert_results_to_battles(results); compute_mle_elo(battles, calibration_framework='RF (default)', calibration_elo=1000)
elo_recipe.battles: one per (task, method pair) at fold 0; ties count as ties
elo_recipe.intervals: bootstrap over tasks, fixed seed, at read time
elo_recipe.our_entrants: enter the same fit under the same recipe on the same tasks
